correctness.rationale: Reconstructed integer-sum p-adic cancellation for each prime: nonzero head residue must use a tail semiprime, so b<=2t. The local residue-maximization inequality gives 1 <= lambda*k + sum_p C_p because 2*mu+1/2001=lambda. Independently coded dictionary residue dynamic programming from the RESULT definition using Python Fraction, modular inverses and conservative integer rounding: exactly 563 eligible pq<=2000, 168 incident primes, 13 positive contributions, total scaled local maxima 704269451136 at 10^12, yielding 0.994269451136<1. This exhausts only the bounded head; the preceding symbolic inequality covers every larger denominator. Watanabe supplies a known 47-term upper witness. All denominators squarefree and pairwise distinct; repeated prime supports are permitted.
residual_risks: Lower bound is r>=41 only; does not determine r or exclude lengths 41..46. Finite DP is a valid certificate only after proving the unrestricted prime-tail inequality.
